chunks: Enquire from the people of that city, or ask the men of the caravan with whom we have come. We are verily speaking the truth.'
ai.seo_question: What did Joseph tell his brothers to verify his truthfulness when they met in Egypt?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) employs a stratagem of verification, directing his brothers to consult the caravan that accompanied them to confirm his narrative, thereby establishing the credibility of his claim before revealing his identity. Shia exegetes highlight this as a demonstration of divine wisdom (hikmah) and the gradual unfolding of truth, where Joseph uses practical means to validate his prophetic status and prepare his brothers for reconciliation. This moment underscores the theme of 'sidq' (truthfulness) not merely as a static attribute but as a dynamic process of confirmation within the broader context of divine decree.
